statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: Proxy reading YES-consistent (well below 2.5%), high confidence. Latest data in the window (BLS, 2022-12-07): Q3 2022 nonfarm business productivity +0.8% annualised q/q but -1.3% y/y; 2021 annual +2.4% (Table 2 vintage); nonfinancial corporate productivity -2.7% y/y, the largest four-quarter decline since 1948. No sign of an AI-driven productivity acceleration.

items.summary: Bloc A's statistics agency revised Q3 2022 nonfarm business labour productivity to +0.8% (annualised) from a preliminary +0.3%; from a year earlier productivity fell 1.3% (output +2.1%, hours +3.4%).
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2022 Revised, USDL 22-2265, 2022-12-07 (verified via web_extract this run). Unit labour costs +2.4% q/q, +5.3% y/y; real hourly compensation -4.0% y/y, the largest four-quarter decline in the series since 1948.

items.summary: In the same release the latest annual figure for nonfarm business labour productivity growth was +2.4% for 2021 (2020: +4.3%), i.e. already near the indicator's 2.5% threshold before the 2022 declines.
items.detail: BLS USDL 22-2265, Table 2 'Nonfarm business sector: Labor productivity, hourly compensation, unit labor costs, and prices', percent change rows: 2021 ANNUAL 2.4; 2020 ANNUAL 4.3 (verified via web_extract this run; read from the saved full text).

items.summary: Nonfinancial corporate sector productivity fell 1.8% (annualised) in Q3 2022 and 2.7% over four quarters - the largest four-quarter decline in that series since 1948.
items.detail: BLS USDL 22-2265, preliminary Q3 2022 nonfinancial corporate measures, Table A2 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: The preliminary Q3 2022 estimate (released shortly before the window) showed productivity +0.3% annualised and -1.4% y/y, the first instance of three consecutive four-quarter declines since 1982.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2022 Preliminary, USDL 22-2096, 2022-11-03 (verified via web_extract this run).
